source.revision: positive safe integer, monotonically increasing per portal
source.identity: ops.tour_property.id in carr-internal, active; never a name or address match
source.authentication: No browser cookie or credential is forwarded. Hosting must authorize the CARR server GET before activation. Existing browser-session-only endpoints fail closed.

list-deal-tour-proposals.output: latest 50 proposals with items, choices, current difference.add/remove, expected_selection_version_id and total pending_count

accept-client-tour-proposal.choices: For per_property, a nonempty map from proposal or original-cart property UUID to desired boolean membership. Unchosen properties retain current membership.
accept-client-tour-proposal.output: receipt with proposal_id, state, actor, selection_version_id and portal_revision

dismiss-client-tour-proposal.output: dismissal receipt; preserves existing shortlist and earlier accepted choices

invariants: Every verb requires an authenticated human partner authorized for the deal.
Portal actors have no proposal mutation route. Source payload and URL are never tool arguments.
Pull creates proposal metadata only. Acceptance appends the existing Tour cart, never a parallel shortlist.
Tour must already belong to the portal deal. Portal ownership cannot be rebound.
Equal portal revision and equal sorted IDs replay the original proposal. Different content or Tour refuses key reuse.
A newer revision supersedes pending and partially accepted proposals without undoing accepted choices.
Acceptance locks the portal then Tour and checks the current cart version. Concurrent stale accepts refuse.
Acceptance and dismissal receipts replay by actor and idempotency key, and refuse changed requests.
Lists and badge counts perform no remote pull. Counts include pending and partially accepted states.
No route, public share, send, financial fields or hosting deployment is created by these verbs.
activation_dependencies: Portal hosting supports and authorizes the source contract
S3 and S4 registry queue lands
Synthetic full-schema CI then production proof under a separately authorized job
